findings.description: Round-2 atlas scenarios are orphaned from tasks: codebase-analysis adds "Coverage footer shape", "Target resolution precedence", "Unique name resolves", and "Direction both labels sections", but tasks 1.1/1.2 Spec scenarios and the 1.1 test body still omit them (no footer multi-language shape/sort/` / ` join assertion, no id-over-name precedence, no unique-name success path, no `--direction both` section labels). plan-findings claims these scenarios were added to close residual SHALLs; without task linkage they will not be implemented or verified.

Explainer Grounding defines `graph check failed` for `--check` spawn/OSError and for `--tree` exit `1` after a fresh `--check`, but no WHEN/THEN scenario exercises either path. The existing "Stale or absent graph falls back to source" WHEN only covers non-zero `--check` or missing script/graph (→ `graph stale` / `graph absent`) yet its THEN also allows `graph check failed`, which those triggers never produce. Round-1 adjudication explicitly separated stale vs check-failed; that distinction is still untestable as written.

Round-2 frontmatter/distribution scenarios are under-wired in tasks. "Frontmatter omits triggers and sets Architecture category" and "Skill markdown ends with required tail sections" are not listed on task 2.1 Spec scenarios; task 2.1 only requires keys present/non-empty and does not require `category: Architecture` or `related` to include both `codebase-atlas` and `refresh-architecture`. "Manifest declares portable distribution and atlas dependencies" is not listed on task 2.6; "Sibling skill paths use skill-base-dir form" is not listed on task 2.5/2.6. Behaviors partially appear in task prose, but Spec scenario linkage and the Architecture/related assertions remain incomplete relative to the added SHALLs.

D7 (and session-log shorthand) tells deterministic tests to treat `graph stale|absent|check failed` as exact tokens, while D5/spec/task 2.2 require three separate reasons: `graph stale`, `graph absent`, `graph check failed`. A literal-token check against the pipe form will fail or under-assert the closed set. Align D7 with the expanded tokens already listed in task 2.2.

Atlas target resolution SHALL accepts a module file path or basename, but only basename is covered ("File target gives the aggregated module view"). There is no scenario for a full module file path resolving to the aggregated module view, so that half of the resolution SHALL is untested.
